description: This file defines template classes for control mechanisms within the WPEFramework messaging system, including ControlType and LocalLifetimeType, which manage control metadata and enable/disable states for messaging categories and modules.

classes.name: ControlType
classes.description: Template class managing control metadata and enable/disable state for a specific control category and module.

classes.name: LocalLifetimeType
classes.description: Template class providing static interface to control a control type's lifetime and enabled state within a module.

methods.name: ControlType()
methods.description: Deleted constructor to prevent default instantiation.

methods.name: ControlType(const bool enabled)
methods.description: Constructor initializing control state and metadata, and registering control.

methods.name: ~ControlType()
methods.description: Destructor that calls Destroy to revoke control if necessary.

methods.name: IsEnabled()
methods.description: Checks if the control is enabled.

methods.name: Enable()
methods.description: Returns whether the control is enabled.

methods.name: Enable(const bool enabled)
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of the control.

methods.name: Destroy()
methods.description: Revokes control if it is currently enabled.

methods.name: LocalLifetimeType()
methods.description: Default constructor for static control management.

methods.name: Announce()
methods.description: Static method to announce control presence.

methods.name: IsEnabled()
methods.description: Static method to check if control is enabled.

methods.name: Enable(const bool enable)
methods.description: Static method to enable or disable control.

methods.name: Metadata()
methods.description: Static method to retrieve control metadata.
